round1_suggestion.risk_reason: 实查 PDF 第 7 页 Fig. 3i：NeuN (Rbfox3) 是外周感觉神经元的泛标志物（pan-neuronal marker），作者在此背景上通过 SA-β-gal 检测衰老细胞。Rbfox3 本身不是衰老特异 marker，基线将其定为 senescent nociceptors 会产生误导，建议更新 cell_type 为 nociceptors/neurons，并备注其泛神经元背景属性。

screening_units.round1_disagreement: 与 Gemini 的保留+更新方向一致；Luna建议收窄实体，不把 NeuN 解释为 senescence-specific。

before_values.source_locator: Results, 'Development and persistence of pain and senescence of pain-sensing neurons', Fig.3i
before_values.source_context: We identified a senescent phenotype in a subset of nociceptors, which were characterized by high expression of the neuronal nuclei marker (NeuN) and their smaller size (Fig.3i).
before_values.notes: 作者明确用 Neuronal nuclei marker NeuN 高表达定义小鼠 DRG 中衰老伤害感受神经元亚群；符号规范化为 RBFOX3。

after_values.source_locator: Results, 'Development and persistence of pain and senescence of pain-sensing neurons', Fig.3i
after_values.source_context: We identified a senescent phenotype in a subset of nociceptors, which were characterized by high expression of the neuronal nuclei marker (NeuN) and their smaller size (Fig.3i).
after_values.notes: NeuN/RBFOX3 is a pan-neuronal nuclear marker; retain the senescence experimental context without treating NeuN as senescence-specific. Luna建议，Astra final.

proposed_changes.reason: NeuN/RBFOX3 是神经元核 marker；原表将该关系压缩为 senescent nociceptors，独立检查支持保留关系，但建议把细胞实体回到 nociceptors/neurons，并在备注中保留衰老实验条件，避免把 NeuN 泛化成衰老特异 marker。

before_values.source_locator: Introduction, paragraph 2: 'Those neurons are of different subtypes...'
before_values.source_context: Those neurons are of different subtypes that are classified as peptidergic (PEPs), non-peptidergic (NPs), C-LowThreshold mechanoreceptor (C-LTMRs), and a subtype of somatostatin positive neurons (SST)
before_values.notes: SST is explicitly used by the authors to define and name a nociceptor subtype ('somatostatin positive neurons (SST)'). It is therefore a formal marker for this cell population, not merely a DEG. The paper's primary model is mouse, so the mouse ortholog Sst is used as the normalized symbol.

before_values.source_locator: Results, 'Development and persistence of pain and senescence of pain-sensing neurons', Fig.3i
before_values.source_context: We identified a senescent phenotype in a subset of nociceptors, which were characterized by high expression of the neuronal nuclei marker (NeuN) and their smaller size (Fig.3i).
before_values.notes: 作者明确用 Neuronal nuclei marker NeuN 高表达定义小鼠 DRG 中衰老伤害感受神经元亚群；符号规范化为 RBFOX3。

after_values.source_locator: Results, 'Development and persistence of pain and senescence of pain-sensing neurons', Fig.3i
after_values.source_context: We identified a senescent phenotype in a subset of nociceptors, which were characterized by high expression of the neuronal nuclei marker (NeuN) and their smaller size (Fig.3i).
after_values.notes: NeuN/RBFOX3 is a pan-neuronal nuclear marker; retain the senescence experimental context without treating NeuN as senescence-specific. Luna建议，Astra final.

sample.reason: NeuN/RBFOX3 是神经元核 marker；原表将该关系压缩为 senescent nociceptors，独立检查支持保留关系，但建议把细胞实体回到 nociceptors/neurons，并在备注中保留衰老实验条件，避免把 NeuN 泛化成衰老特异 marker。

before_values.source_locator: Introduction, paragraph 2: 'Those neurons are of different subtypes...'
before_values.source_context: Those neurons are of different subtypes that are classified as peptidergic (PEPs), non-peptidergic (NPs), C-LowThreshold mechanoreceptor (C-LTMRs), and a subtype of somatostatin positive neurons (SST)
before_values.notes: SST is explicitly used by the authors to define and name a nociceptor subtype ('somatostatin positive neurons (SST)'). It is therefore a formal marker for this cell population, not merely a DEG. The paper's primary model is mouse, so the mouse ortholog Sst is used as the normalized symbol.

(E) The early-stage tip epithelium at 10 pcw expresses SOX9 and TPPP3, and gains the expression of the alveolar lineage marker, SFTPC, at late stages, 15 and 19 pcw. The SFTPC+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT2 cells) at 15 and 19 pcw lack SOX9 and TPPP3 expression (SOX9-TPPP3-SFTPC+). (F) Arrowheads indicate CD36+PDPN- tips.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S1D-F immunofluorescence clearly distinguishes distal tip epithelium (SOX9+, SFTPC+, CD36+, PDPN-) from proximal airway epithelium (SOX2+) and stalk cells.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates SOX9, TPPP3, SFTPC, CD36 in tip epithelium, SOX2 in airway epithelium, and negative gating of PDPN in tips.

EVID_07.view_scope: STEM Fig.S1 caption/text image; tip epithelium, airway, fetal AT2 and CD36/PDPN gates

existing_round1_entry.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
existing_round1_entry.locator: Figure S5E, S5M, S5N, S5O, S5P & legend (p. 40-41)
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: (E) WNT2, alveolar fibroblasts, white; NOTUM, myofibroblasts, red; CD44, tip epithelium, green. (M) Summary diagram showing the spatial regulation of Wnt signalling mediated by ACTA2+PDGFRa+CD141+ myofibroblasts. (N) Time course analysis of NOTUM+ myofibroblasts, SCGB3A2+ terminal airway cells, and SFTPC+ tip and stalk. (O and P) Time-course visualization (O) and quantitation (P) of SFTPC-/SPOCK2+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT1 cells) and SFTPC+/SPOCK2- stalk cells (fetal AT2 cells)... SPOCK2, red, AT1 cell marker; SFTPC, green, AT2 cell marker; white, NKX2.1, lung epithelial cell marker.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S5 panels show spatial localization of NOTUM+/ACTA2+/PDGFRA+/CD141+ myofibroblasts and WNT2+ alveolar fibroblasts. Stalk regions contain distinct SPOCK2+ (AT1) and SFTPC+ (AT2) subpopulations.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates myofibroblast markers (NOTUM, ACTA2, PDGFRA, THBD), alveolar fibroblast marker (WNT2), AT1 marker (SPOCK2), and terminal airway (SCGB3A2).

EVID_08.view_scope: STEM Fig.S5 caption/text image; WNT2/NOTUM/CD44 and SFTPC/SPOCK2 stalk identities

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: We detected ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, ALOX15+) from 11 pcw, interspersed with secretory/club cells (Figures 2A–2C, S3H, S4A, and S4B). Rarer deuterosomal cells (FOXJ1+, CDC20B+) appeared at the same time. MUC16+ ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, DNAH+, MUC16LO) were also detected... Tip cells express a core set of tip-specific markers (SOX9+, ETV5+, TESC+, TPPP3+, and STC1+).
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 2C dot plot illustrates gene expression across epithelial lineages: FOXJ1 and ALOX15 in ciliated cells; CDC20B in deuterosomal cells; SOX9 and ETV5 in tip cells; MUC16, SCGB1A1, SCGB3A1, SCGB3A2 in distinct secretory subsets.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates ciliated, deuterosomal, tip, and secretory lineage markers.

EVID_09.view_scope: CELL Fig.2 caption/text image; NE and secretory/airway marker panels

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: The broad fibroblast cluster comprises fibroblasts, myofibroblasts, airway and vascular smooth muscle (ASM and vSMC), pericytes, mesothelium, and chondrocytes (Figures 4A and 4B). Airway fibroblasts and chondrocytes were proximally enriched and mesothelium distally enriched... Isolated PDGFRA+CD141+ myofibroblasts express high levels of ACTA2, NOTUM, and LEF1. Whereas PDGFRA-CD141- fibroblasts express high levels of WNT2 and FGFR4.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 4B dot plot displays distinct expression signatures for mesenchymal subsets: ASPN, COL2A1 in chondrocytes; ACTA2, TAGLN in ASM; PLN, NTN4 in vSMC; WNT2 in alveolar fibroblasts; WNT2B, FGF10 in airway fibroblasts.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Primary validation for mesenchymal subsets (myofibroblast, ASM, vSMC, pericyte, chondrocyte, adventitial/alveolar/airway fibroblasts).

EVID_10.view_scope: CELL Fig.4 caption/text image; mesenchymal/vSMC/myofibroblast marker panels

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: ASCL1 and NEUROD1 regulate the formation of two subtypes of neuroendocrine cells. Classical pulmonary NE cells (GRP+) and GHRL+ NE cells (TTR+, GHRL+)... NEUROD1 was co-expressed with GHRL but also observed with GRP, whereas NEUROG3 was co-expressed with ASCL1 and/or NEUROD1, supporting a role in a transition population.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 7A-E clearly delineates the bifurcated trajectory of NE cells: ASCL1/GRP in classical PNEC vs NEUROD1/GHRL/TTR/RFX6 in GHRL+ NE, with NEUROG3 marking intermediate progenitors.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Core evidence resolving PNEC vs GHRL+ NE vs intermediate NE cell granularity and TF markers.

EVID_11.view_scope: CELL Fig.7 caption/text image; GRP+ and GHRL+ pulmonary NE, ASCL1/NEUROD1/NEUROG3/RFX6

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: At 5–6 pcw, the endothelial cells (ECs) comprised capillary (early Cap: THY1+, CD24+), GRIA2+ arterial (GRIA2+, GJA5+), and lymphatic ECs (PROX1+, STAB1+, and UCP2LO)... Aerocytes express CA4 and S100A3... PLN is expressed in ASM but absent from vSMC.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S7B dot plot shows endothelial marker breakdown (CA4, S100A3, EDNRB in aerocytes; GJA5, EFNB2 in arterial EC; ACKR3, NR2F2 in venous EC; PROX1, STAB1 in lymphatic EC). Figure S7F-H shows vSMC (NDUFA4L2+, PLN-) vs adventitial fibroblast (NTRK3+, NDUFA4L2-).
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates endothelial specialization subsets and vSMC/fibroblast distinction.

EVID_12.view_scope: CELL Fig.S7 caption/text image; aerocyte/endothelial/vascular SMC/fibroblast markers

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: (C) Expression of NEUROD1, GHRL, and GRP in PNEC vs GHRL+ NE cells. (D) Co-expression analysis of NEUROG3 with ASCL1 and NEUROD1. (E) HCR staining for RFX6 in GHRL+ NE cells.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S8C-E shows mutually exclusive or enriched expression patterns confirming GHRL and NEUROD1 are positive in GHRL+ NE and negative in classic PNEC, whereas GRP is positive in classic PNEC and negative in GHRL+ NE.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Supports polarity and specificity of NE subtype transcription factors and peptide hormones.

It is unclear how genetic aberrations impact the state of nascent tumour cells and their
microenvironment. BRCA1 driven triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) has been shown to
arise from luminal progenitors yet little is known about how BRCA1 loss-of-function (LOF) and
concomitant mutations affect the luminal progenitor cell state. Here we demonstrate how
time-resolved single-cell pro ﬁling of genetically engineered mouse models before tumour
formation can address this challenge. We found that perturbing Brca1/p53 in luminal pro-
genitors induces aberrant alveolar differentiation pre-malignancy accompanied by pro-
tumourigenic changes in the immune compartment. Unlike alveolar differentiation during
gestation, this process is cell autonomous and characterised by the dysregulation of tran-
scription factors driving alveologenesis. Based on our data we propose a model where Brca1/
p53 LOF inadvertently promotes a differentiation program hardwired in luminal progenitors,
highlighting the deterministic role of the cell-of-origin and offering a potential explanation for
the tissue speci ﬁcity of BRCA1 tumours.

A single-cell time-lapse of mouse prenatal 
development from gastrula to birth
Chengxiang Qiu1,18 ✉, Beth K. Martin1,18, Ian C. Welsh2,18, Riza M. Daza1, Truc-Mai Le3, 
Xingfan Huang1,4, Eva K. Nichols1, Megan L. Taylor1,3, Olivia Fulton1, Diana R. O’Day3, 
Anne Roshella Gomes3, Saskia Ilcisin3, Sanjay Srivatsan1,5, Xinxian Deng6, 
Christine M. Disteche6,7, William Stafford Noble1,4, Nobuhiko Hamazaki1,8, Cecilia B. Moens9, 
David Kimelman1,10, Junyue Cao11, Alexander F. Schier12,13, Malte Spielmann14,15,16, 
Stephen A. Murray2, Cole Trapnell1,3,13,17 & Jay Shendure1 ,3,8,13,17 ✉
The house mouse (Mus musculus) is an exceptional model system, combining genetic 
tractability with close evolutionary affinity to humans1,2. Mouse gestation lasts only 3 
weeks, during which the genome orchestrates the astonishing transformation of a 
single-cell zygote into a free-living pup composed of more than 500 million cells. 
Here, to establish a global framework for exploring mammalian development, we 
applied optimized single-cell combinatorial indexing3 to profile the transcriptional 
states of 12.4 million nuclei from 83 embryos, precisely staged at 2- to 6-hour intervals 
spanning late gastrulation (embryonic day 8) to birth (postnatal day 0). From these 
data, we annotate hundreds of cell types and explore the ontogenesis of the posterior 
embryo during somitogenesis and of kidney, mesenchyme, retina and early neurons. 
We leverage the temporal resolution and sampling depth of these whole-embryo 
snapshots, together with published data4– 8 from earlier timepoints, to construct a 
rooted tree of cell-type relationships that spans the entirety of prenatal development, 
from zygote to birth. Throughout this tree, we systematically nominate genes 
encoding transcription factors and other proteins as candidate drivers of the in vivo 
differentiation of hundreds of cell types. Remarkably, the most marked temporal 
shifts in cell states are observed within one hour of birth and presumably underlie the 
massive physiological adaptations that must accompany the successful transition of a 
mammalian fetus to life outside the womb.

integration of different experimental techniques and used them to assess 
variability in cell type composition and expression as well as emerging spatial 
expression characteristics across clinicopathological and methodological 
diversity. Finally, we assessed spatial expression and co-localization features 
of macrophage populations, characterized three distinct spatial phenotypes 
of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition and identified expression programs 
associated with local T cell infiltration versus exclusion, showcasing the 
potential of clinically relevant discovery in such maps.

Abstract
The peripheral nerve contains diverse cell types that support its proper function and maintenance. 
We analyzed multiple peripheral nerves using single-nuclei RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq), which

and Pmp2 and preferentially ensheathes motor axons. The number of these motor-associated, 
Pmp2+ SCs is reduced in both ALS SOD1G93A mouse model and human ALS nerve samples.

reference for future studies of nerve biology and disease.
